! JO9 MOD START VOICE_RECENT_PICKER | 2026-10-17_zzzzzzzzzz_voice_recent
! 발언이 확정된 곳에서만 호출한다. 화면 그리기에는 호출하지 않는다.
! dynslave는 기존 인스턴스 치환 관례다. $args[0]은 질문/출력 항목 키다.
! 입력 임시 배열: $jo9_voice_candidates, $jo9_voice_candidate_ids. 반환: 고른 발언.
! 저장: 해당 인물 배열의 jo9_voice_last1_<항목>, jo9_voice_last2_<항목> 두 문자열.
$voice_pick_recent = {
 $result = ''
 jo9_vpick_count = min(arrsize('$jo9_voice_candidates'), arrsize('$jo9_voice_candidate_ids'))
 jo9_vpick_selected = -1
 if jo9_vpick_count > 0:
  $jo9_vpick_key1 = 'jo9_voice_last1_' + $args[0]
  $jo9_vpick_key2 = 'jo9_voice_last2_' + $args[0]
  $jo9_vpick_previous1 = $dynslave[$jo9_vpick_key1]
  $jo9_vpick_previous2 = $dynslave[$jo9_vpick_key2]
  jo9_vpick_start = dyneval($voice_index, dynslave['id'] mod 10000, jo9_vpick_count)
  jo9_vpick_pass = 0
  :jo9_vpick_next_pass
  jo9_vpick_scan = 0
  :jo9_vpick_scan_candidate
  jo9_vpick_at = (jo9_vpick_start + jo9_vpick_scan) mod jo9_vpick_count
  $jo9_vpick_id = $jo9_voice_candidate_ids[jo9_vpick_at]
  jo9_vpick_allowed = 1
  if $jo9_voice_candidates[jo9_vpick_at] = '' or $jo9_vpick_id = '': jo9_vpick_allowed = 0
  if jo9_vpick_pass < 2 and $jo9_vpick_id = $jo9_vpick_previous1: jo9_vpick_allowed = 0
  if jo9_vpick_pass = 0 and $jo9_vpick_id = $jo9_vpick_previous2: jo9_vpick_allowed = 0
  if jo9_vpick_allowed = 1: jo9_vpick_selected = jo9_vpick_at
  jo9_vpick_scan += 1
  if jo9_vpick_selected < 0 and jo9_vpick_scan < jo9_vpick_count: jump 'jo9_vpick_scan_candidate'
  jo9_vpick_pass += 1
  ! 후보가 적으면 최근 한 개만 회피하고, 그것도 불가능하면 사용 가능한 후보를 허용한다.
  if jo9_vpick_selected < 0 and jo9_vpick_pass < 3: jump 'jo9_vpick_next_pass'
  if jo9_vpick_selected >= 0:
   $result = $jo9_voice_candidates[jo9_vpick_selected]
   $dynslave[$jo9_vpick_key2] = $jo9_vpick_previous1
   $dynslave[$jo9_vpick_key1] = $jo9_voice_candidate_ids[jo9_vpick_selected]
  end
 end
 killvar 'jo9_vpick_count'
 killvar 'jo9_vpick_selected'
 killvar '$jo9_vpick_key1'
 killvar '$jo9_vpick_key2'
 killvar '$jo9_vpick_previous1'
 killvar '$jo9_vpick_previous2'
 killvar 'jo9_vpick_start'
 killvar 'jo9_vpick_pass'
 killvar 'jo9_vpick_scan'
 killvar 'jo9_vpick_at'
 killvar '$jo9_vpick_id'
 killvar 'jo9_vpick_allowed'
}
! JO9 MOD END VOICE_RECENT_PICKER
